_comment: Declarative rules catalog for SARATHI. Decouples applicability conditions, statutory triggers, verification checks, and explanations from catalog metadata.

company_incorporation.applicableReason: SPICe+ incorporation via the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) is mandatory for corporate entities (Private Limited, Public Limited, or OPC).
company_incorporation.notApplicableReason: Your legal structure does not require MCA corporate incorporation (proprietorships, general partnerships, and cooperatives operate under separate non-corporate statutes).
triggeredBy: Legal structure is Private Limited, Public Limited, or One Person Company

startup_dpiit.applicableReason: You indicated startup status with an eligible entity structure — DPIIT recognition unlocks Section 80-IAC tax exemptions, fast-tracked patent filings, and seed funding access.
startup_dpiit.potentiallyApplicableReason: You indicated startup intent, but DPIIT recognition strictly requires a registered Private Limited Company, LLP, or registered Partnership (Sole Proprietorships are not eligible under Startup India rules).
startup_dpiit.notApplicableReason: Not indicated as you did not register this venture as an innovative startup under DPIIT criteria.
triggeredBy: Startup recognition intent
Eligible constitution structure
verificationConditions: Verification of entity incorporation date (< 10 years)
Proof of innovation or scalable business model

udyam.applicableReason: Mandatory national MSME registration under MSMED Act, 2006. Classifies your enterprise and unlocks priority lending, collateral-free loans, and delayed payment protections.
udyam.notApplicableReason: Investment and turnover exceed the statutory MSME ceiling (Large enterprise).
triggeredBy: Investment and turnover fall within Micro, Small, or Medium enterprise thresholds

gst.applicableReason: GST registration is mandatory under CGST Act, 2017 Section 22/24 due to turnover thresholds, interstate sales, or corporate B2B trading requirement.
gst.potentiallyApplicableReason: Turnover may be below the mandatory threshold (₹40L for goods, ₹20L for services), but voluntary GST registration is strongly advised to claim Input Tax Credit (ITC) and open commercial current accounts.
gst.notApplicableReason: Exclusively engaged in non-taxable agricultural produce with no commercial or interstate turnover.
triggeredBy: Turnover criteria or B2B/interstate operations
verificationConditions: Verify whether first-year turnover will exceed statutory threshold
Check if selling goods interstate or via e-commerce

trade_licence.applicableReason: Mandatory trade licence required under State Municipalities Act / Municipal Corporation Act to operate a commercial establishment within urban municipal jurisdiction.
trade_licence.potentiallyApplicableReason: Premises is located in a Gram Panchayat or Industrial Area where Gram Panchayat D&O licence or Industrial Area Local Authority (IALA) clearance applies.
trade_licence.notApplicableReason: No physical commercial premises detected (e.g. 100% remote digital service with no commercial walk-in or premises footprint).
triggeredBy: Physical commercial premises located in urban municipal boundary
verificationConditions: Verify local municipal ward and property tax assessment number of the premises

shops.applicableReason: Mandatory registration under State Shops & Establishments Act governing operating hours, employee welfare, statutory leave, and working conditions.
shops.potentiallyApplicableReason: Operating with employees; check if local labour inspector requires registration for virtual or co-working addresses.
shops.notApplicableReason: Your unit is registered as a manufacturing factory under the Factories Act, 1948, which explicitly exempts premises from the Shops & Establishments Act.
triggeredBy: Commercial establishment with physical premises not covered under Factories Act
verificationConditions: Check state-specific threshold on minimum employee count for mandatory registration

cte.applicableReason: Consent to Establish (CTE) is mandatory under Water Act, 1974 (Sec 25) & Air Act, 1981 (Sec 21) from State Pollution Control Board before starting civil construction or machinery installation.
cte.potentiallyApplicableReason: Green category pollution activity — eligible for simplified online consent or white-category self-declaration depending on local SPCB industrial zone norms.
cte.notApplicableReason: Classified as WHITE category by the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) — non-polluting activities are completely exempted from environmental consents.
triggeredBy: Industrial activity with environmental emissions / effluents (Orange or Red category)
verificationConditions: Detailed Project Report (DPR)
Site layout plan and effluent treatment scheme

cto.applicableReason: Consent to Operate (CTO) is mandatory under Water Act & Air Act before commencing trial production or commercial operations.
cto.potentiallyApplicableReason: Green category — requires operational intimation or simplified CTO depending on state PCB norms.
cto.notApplicableReason: Non-polluting white category business — exempted from pollution control operations consent.
triggeredBy: Post-installation operational clearance required for polluting manufacturing processes
verificationConditions: Compliance report of CTE conditions
Adequacy of pollution control equipment installed

factory_licence.applicableReason: Factory Plan Approval & Licence is mandatory under Factories Act, 1948 (Sec 6 & 12) for manufacturing units employing 10+ workers with power or 20+ workers without power.
factory_licence.potentiallyApplicableReason: Manufacturing activity with machinery detected, but current workforce is below the statutory threshold (10 with power / 20 without). Final applicability depends on seasonal workforce expansions or local factory inspectorate verification.
factory_licence.notApplicableReason: Business does not conduct a manufacturing process (retail, IT, hospitality, consulting, or services are governed by Shops & Establishments instead).
triggeredBy: Manufacturing activity with machinery and workforce meeting statutory thresholds
verificationConditions: Verify exact number of workers on the manufacturing floor
Connected electrical power load in HP/kW

fire_noc.applicableReason: Fire Safety NOC from State Disaster Response & Fire Services is mandatory for manufacturing factories, hazardous chemical units, and commercial premises with high fire risk.
fire_noc.potentiallyApplicableReason: Fire NOC applicability depends on physical building parameters (height > 15 metres, built-up area > 500 sq. metres, or restaurant seating > 50 covers) subject to local fire authority review.
fire_noc.notApplicableReason: Low-risk, ground-floor commercial premises or home office with built-up area below statutory fire department inspection thresholds.
triggeredBy: Industrial manufacturing, hazardous storage, or commercial building occupancy
verificationConditions: Building height and total built-up area in square metres
Sanctioned architectural building plan showing fire egress routes

power_connection.applicableReason: Commercial / Industrial power connection and load sanction required from the electricity distribution company (DISCOM) for production and commercial machinery.
power_connection.potentiallyApplicableReason: Standard commercial premises — check if existing landlord meter load is adequate or commercial category conversion is required.
power_connection.notApplicableReason: No commercial or industrial electric power load needed (e.g. home office or non-powered manual unit).
triggeredBy: High-load electricity usage or industrial machinery on premises

fssai.applicableReason: Mandatory Food Safety Licence / Registration under Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 for handling, preparing, processing, packaging, distributing, or selling food items.
fssai.notApplicableReason: Your business does not involve food, edible products, or beverage handling.
triggeredBy: Food handling, processing, preparation, or distribution activity
missingInfo: Water testing analysis report (from NABL accredited lab)

bis_isi.applicableReason: Mandatory BIS ISI Mark Certification under BIS Act, 2016 (e.g. IS 14543 for Packaged Drinking Water, IS 13428 for Mineral Water) before commercial packaging and sale.
bis_isi.potentiallyApplicableReason: Check if your manufactured products are covered under the Central Government's expanding mandatory Quality Control Orders (QCO).
bis_isi.notApplicableReason: Product is not subject to mandatory Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification.
triggeredBy: Manufacture or packaging of products under mandatory BIS Quality Control Orders
verificationConditions: In-house laboratory test facilities
Calibration certificates for testing equipment

drug_licence.applicableReason: Mandatory Drug Licence (Form 20/21) under Drugs & Cosmetics Act, 1940 from State Drugs Control Administration for stocking, selling, or distributing medicines.
drug_licence.notApplicableReason: Business does not stock, dispense, manufacture, or distribute pharmaceutical drugs or medical formulations.
triggeredBy: Pharmaceutical, medical store, or drug distribution activity
missingInfo: Registered Pharmacist certificate & state pharmacy council registration
Premises minimum carpet area proof (10 sq.m / 15 sq.m)

eating_house.applicableReason: Mandatory Eating House Licence from the City Police Commissionerate / District Magistrate to operate a public dining or refreshment establishment.
eating_house.potentiallyApplicableReason: Cloud kitchen / takeaway food business — police eating house rules vary by city when customers do not enter the premises.
eating_house.notApplicableReason: Business is not an eating house, restaurant, or public dining establishment.
triggeredBy: Public food service establishment with customer dining
verificationConditions: NOC from local police station
Fire safety clearance and municipal trade licence

excise_licence.applicableReason: Mandatory State Prohibition & Excise Licence required to purchase, store, dispense, or serve alcoholic beverages, wine, or spirits.
excise_licence.notApplicableReason: Your business does not store, sell, or serve alcoholic beverages.
triggeredBy: Sale or service of alcoholic beverages
missingInfo: Excise layout plan with distance from religious/educational institutions (> 100m)

legal_metrology.applicableReason: Mandatory verification and stamping of commercial weighing and measuring instruments under Legal Metrology Act, 2009.
legal_metrology.potentiallyApplicableReason: Selling or manufacturing pre-packaged commodities requires registration under Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.
legal_metrology.notApplicableReason: Business does not sell goods by weight or measure or use commercial weighing scales.
triggeredBy: Use of commercial weighing/measuring instruments or packaged commodities trade
verificationConditions: Model approval certificate of weighing instrument
Verification stamping by Legal Metrology Inspector

epf.applicableReason: Mandatory EPF Registration under Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 for any enterprise employing 20 or more workers.
epf.potentiallyApplicableReason: Employing between 10 and 19 workers — voluntary EPF registration is available to provide retirement benefits to attract talent.
epf.notApplicableReason: Workforce is below the statutory mandatory threshold of 20 employees.
triggeredBy: Total employee count is 20 or greater
missingInfo: Employee Aadhaar and bank details for Universal Account Number (UAN) generation

esi.applicableReason: Mandatory ESI Registration under Employees' State Insurance Act, 1948 for commercial and industrial establishments employing 10 or more workers.
esi.potentiallyApplicableReason: Workforce close to threshold — ESI applies immediately once total headcount reaches 10 in an ESI-notified district.
esi.notApplicableReason: Workforce is below the statutory threshold of 10 employees.
triggeredBy: Total employee count is 10 or greater
missingInfo: Employee salary register showing monthly gross wage structure

groundwater_noc.applicableReason: Mandatory Ground Water Extraction NOC from Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA) / State Ground Water Department for industrial or commercial borewell extraction.
groundwater_noc.notApplicableReason: No commercial borewell groundwater extraction (water sourced through municipal piped supply, tankers, or treated sources).
triggeredBy: Commercial or industrial extraction of groundwater via borewell
missingInfo: Digital flow meter installation with telemetry
Rainwater harvesting and artificial recharge plan

iec_code.applicableReason: Mandatory Import Export Code (IEC) from DGFT under Foreign Trade (Development & Regulation) Act, 1992 for any business engaged in import or export of goods or services.
iec_code.notApplicableReason: Business does not engage in import or export of goods or services.
triggeredBy: Import or export of goods or services across international borders
missingInfo: Bank account details for foreign exchange transactions

rera.applicableReason: Mandatory RERA Registration under Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 for any real estate project exceeding 500 sq.m or 8 apartments.
rera.notApplicableReason: Business is not involved in real estate development, construction, or property sales.
triggeredBy: Real estate development or construction activity
missingInfo: Approved building plan from municipal authority

nbfc_registration.applicableReason: Mandatory NBFC Registration from Reserve Bank of India under RBI Act, 1934 Chapter IIIB for any company engaged in lending, investment, or financial asset acquisition.
nbfc_registration.potentiallyApplicableReason: Finance sector business — verify if activities constitute lending, deposit-taking, or financial intermediation requiring RBI registration.
nbfc_registration.notApplicableReason: Business does not engage in lending, deposit-taking, or financial intermediation regulated by RBI.
triggeredBy: Lending, deposit-taking, or financial intermediation activity
missingInfo: Detailed business plan for RBI scrutiny

osp_licence.applicableReason: DOT Other Service Provider (OSP) Registration required under Indian Telegraph Act, 1885 for call centers, BPOs, and IT-enabled services using telecom resources.
osp_licence.potentiallyApplicableReason: IT services business — verify if operations involve telecom resources (EPABX, VoIP, leased circuits) requiring OSP registration.
osp_licence.notApplicableReason: Business does not operate call center, BPO, or IT-enabled services using telecom infrastructure.
triggeredBy: Call center, BPO, or ITES operation using telecom resources

peso_licence.applicableReason: Mandatory PESO Licence under Explosives Act, 1884 / Petroleum Act, 1934 for storage, handling, or transport of petroleum, compressed gases, or explosive substances.
peso_licence.potentiallyApplicableReason: Business handles fuel or petroleum products — verify if storage exceeds the prescribed limits requiring a PESO licence.
peso_licence.notApplicableReason: Business does not store, handle, or transport petroleum, compressed gas, or explosive substances.
triggeredBy: Storage or handling of petroleum, gas, or explosives beyond prescribed limits

clinical_establishment.applicableReason: Mandatory Registration under Clinical Establishments (Registration & Regulation) Act, 2010 for hospitals, nursing homes, clinics, diagnostic centres, and pathological labs.
clinical_establishment.potentiallyApplicableReason: Healthcare sector business — verify if the establishment provides clinical services requiring registration.
clinical_establishment.notApplicableReason: Business does not operate a hospital, clinic, diagnostic centre, or any clinical establishment.
triggeredBy: Operation of hospital, clinic, diagnostic lab, or nursing home

environmental_clearance.applicableReason: Mandatory Environmental Clearance under EIA Notification, 2006 (Environment Protection Act, 1986) for projects listed in Schedule I/II based on investment size and environmental impact.
environmental_clearance.potentiallyApplicableReason: Orange pollution category business — verify if investment or activity falls under EIA Schedule requiring prior environmental clearance from SEIAA/MoEFCC.
environmental_clearance.notApplicableReason: Project does not fall under EIA Notification Schedule categories requiring environmental clearance.
triggeredBy: High-impact industrial or infrastructure project listed under EIA Schedule

hazardous_waste.applicableReason: Mandatory Hazardous Waste Authorization from State Pollution Control Board under Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management & Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016.
hazardous_waste.potentiallyApplicableReason: Red category industry — verify if manufacturing process generates hazardous waste listed in HW Rules Schedule I/II.
hazardous_waste.notApplicableReason: Business does not generate, store, or handle any hazardous waste as defined under HW Rules 2016.
triggeredBy: Generation, storage, or handling of hazardous waste
missingInfo: Waste inventory with HW Schedule category codes
MoU with authorized TSDF (Treatment, Storage & Disposal Facility)

epr_registration.applicableReason: Mandatory Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) Registration from CPCB under Plastic Waste Management Rules, 2016 (amended 2022) for producers, importers, and brand owners using plastic packaging.
epr_registration.potentiallyApplicableReason: Sells packaged goods — verify if packaging involves plastic materials requiring EPR registration.
epr_registration.notApplicableReason: Business does not produce, import, or use plastic packaging materials.
triggeredBy: Use of plastic packaging for products

contract_labour.applicableReason: Mandatory registration and licence under Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act, 1970 for principal employers engaging 20 or more contract workers.
contract_labour.potentiallyApplicableReason: Engaging fewer than 20 contract workers — some states have lowered the threshold; verify local applicability.
contract_labour.notApplicableReason: Business does not engage contract labour or engages fewer than the statutory threshold.
triggeredBy: Engagement of 20 or more contract workers through a contractor
missingInfo: List of contract workers with wage records

professional_tax.applicableReason: Mandatory Professional Tax Registration under the applicable State Professional Tax Act for employers paying salaries — applicable in most Indian states (e.g., Telangana, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Gujarat).
professional_tax.notApplicableReason: Business has no salaried employees or operates in a state without Professional Tax (e.g., Delhi, Rajasthan).
triggeredBy: Employment of salaried individuals in a state that levies Professional Tax

mining_lease.applicableReason: Mandatory Mining Lease / Licence under Mines and Minerals (Development & Regulation) Act, 1957 (MMDR Act) for any mining or quarrying activity.
mining_lease.notApplicableReason: Business does not involve mining, quarrying, or mineral extraction.
triggeredBy: Mining, quarrying, or mineral extraction activity
missingInfo: Approved mining plan from Indian Bureau of Mines (IBM)

dgca_approval.applicableReason: Mandatory DGCA Registration and Remote Pilot Licence under Aircraft Act, 1934 and Drone Rules, 2021 for commercial drone operations.
dgca_approval.potentiallyApplicableReason: Aviation-related business — verify if operations require DGCA approvals for aircraft or drone usage.
dgca_approval.notApplicableReason: Business does not operate drones, unmanned aircraft, or aviation services.
triggeredBy: Commercial drone operations or aviation services

vehicle_fitness.applicableReason: Mandatory Commercial Vehicle Fitness Certificate and Route Permit under Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 for all commercial goods and passenger transport vehicles.
vehicle_fitness.potentiallyApplicableReason: Logistics business — verify if operations involve owned or leased commercial vehicles requiring fitness certificates and permits.
vehicle_fitness.notApplicableReason: Business does not own or operate commercial transport vehicles.
triggeredBy: Ownership or operation of commercial goods or passenger vehicles
missingInfo: Valid PUC and insurance for each vehicle
